hero.lede: I build software, AI agents and automations that solve real problems.
hero.sub: Co-founder & CTO at IndiqAI · Technical Operations at Volanos · Master’s student in Science, Technology & Innovation at UFRN.
p1.d: SaaS platform for small and mid-sized businesses: digital loyalty cards, stamps, rewards, QR codes and referral programs. As CTO I own the multitenant architecture, Row Level Security, async processing, observability and AI-agent-assisted development.
p2.d: A second brain for AI agents: it stores decisions, preferences and context and serves them to any assistant over MCP, with semantic search, provenance and memory lifecycle.
p3.d: People and agents share authorized knowledge while personal memory, company content and restricted data stay apart. The core decision: permissions are enforced by the architecture before vector retrieval — never by the model.
p4.d: Turns CRM data into a neighborhood map of Natal to decide who to approach, which areas to prioritize and how to plan routes — with an AI copilot that runs authorized sales actions. Built mobile-first.
p4.n: internal tool · used by the sales team
p5.d: Community package that brings Dify into n8n workflows: chat, files, audio and streaming responses, no hand-built HTTP calls.
p6.k: AI customer service for accounting firms
p6.d: An AI support and automation platform for accounting firms. I led product concept, feature definition and development.
x.intro: I’ve worked across data analysis, full-stack development, DevOps, project management and entrepreneurship. Today my technical decisions weigh the code, the product, the operation and the business.
x1.d: Architecture and technical direction: backend, frontend, database, security, infrastructure and integrations. I coordinate AI-agent-assisted development — defining requirements, reviewing changes and making sure everything works end to end.
x2.d: Technical operations, automations, integrations and infrastructure for projects in Canada and the US. I lead the architecture of the Volanos Shared Brain: corporate memory, access control and data governance.
x3.d: Data, full stack, DevOps, project management and technical leadership. I learned to tie engineering to commercial priorities, budgets and teams, including projects in Rio Grande do Norte’s innovation ecosystem such as Conexão Hub.
x4.d: AI customer-service and automation platform for the accounting sector. Selected for Startup Nordeste 3 (16th of 60).
x5.d: A marketing and automation company. My first management experience: clients, team, processes and commercial delivery.
x6.d: Taught robotics, programming, electronics and logic — and learned to explain technical topics to every level.
a1.d: International at the IEEE/I3E Entrepreneurship Challenge LATAM, with IndiqAI.
a3.d: IndiqAI validation at GO!RN, with over 1 million reported interactions.
a4.d: Among 60 selected at Startup Nordeste 3, with ChatCont.
a5.d: In UFRN’s master’s admission, the youngest in the cohort.
a6.d: Alternate student representative on the PPgCTI/UFRN board.
a7.d: Selected and advanced in Startup Nordeste and Catalisa ICT with startup projects.
a8.d: Open-source package n8n-nodes-difyai published for the community.
r.p1: In the Professional Master’s in Science, Technology & Innovation at UFRN, I’m building and validating a privacy-preserving analytics module for loyalty and referral ecosystems.
r.p2: The research combines statistical analysis, privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), Brazil’s LGPD and Design Science Research, using IndiqAI as a real-world application context. Advisor: Prof. Dr. Orivaldo Vieira de Santana Junior.
e1.t: Professional Master’s in Science, Technology & Innovation
e2.t: Associate degree in Systems Analysis & Development
e3.t: Technical degree in Digital Game Programming
e4.t: Maker: electronics, robotics, 3D printing and ESP32
w.h: Understand the problem before picking the technology.
w1.d: Understanding limits, dependencies and risks avoids decisions that get expensive later.
w2.d: I use agents to extend what I can execute — but generated code is not validated code.
w3.d: Permissions, data integrity, failure recovery and observability are part of the solution.
w4.d: Done means it meets the real goal under real conditions, not that the screen loads.
w5.d: Build, test, find problems, fix them and watch systems in use.
w6: “I like understanding how things work and finding ways to make them work better.”
c.d: Software architecture, SaaS products, applied AI, autonomous agents, automation and technical challenges that take more than shipping features.

meta.desc: Gabriel Buarque is a Software Architect, AI Builder and CTO at IndiqAI, building software, AI agents, agent memory (MCP) and automations for real problems.
meta.ogtitle: Gabriel Buarque — Software Architect · AI Builder · CTO
meta.ogdesc: I build software, AI agents and automations that solve real problems. CTO at IndiqAI.
b.intro: What I built, broke and learned with automation and AI — straight from practice.
f1.a: Gabriel Buarque is a Software Architect, AI Builder and Automation Architect from Natal, Brazil. He is co-founder and CTO of IndiqAI, Technical Operations Specialist at Volanos and a master’s student in Science, Technology & Innovation at UFRN.
f2.a: IndiqAI is a SaaS loyalty and referral-marketing platform for small and mid-sized businesses, with digital loyalty cards, stamps, rewards, QR codes and referral programs. During validation it reported 730+ users, 1 million+ interactions and 400+ rewards redeemed.
f3.a: Nnexus is a persistent memory layer for AI agents. It stores decisions, preferences and project context and makes them available to different assistants over MCP (Model Context Protocol), with semantic search and provenance tracking.
f4.q: Which technologies does Gabriel work with?
f4.a: Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Docker, n8n and Dify, plus LLMs, AI agents, MCP, RAG and context engineering. Infrastructure on Linux, Coolify, Easypanel, Cloudflare and GitHub Actions.
f5.q: How can I contact Gabriel Buarque?
f5.a: By email at buarquegabriel01@gmail.com, on LinkedIn (gabrielbuarque-cto) or on GitHub (gabrielbuarque). He is interested in software architecture, SaaS, applied AI, autonomous agents and automation projects.
